content: {"like":["Values gritty, documentary‑style visuals and high production quality on Blu‑Ray","Prefers strong, flawed characters and character‑driven storytelling that appeals beyond genre fans","Appreciates realistic science and subtle, thoughtful narratives","Enjoys well‑crafted, iconic set pieces and strong female character arcs","Loves humor that is profane yet clever, and appreciates solid acting and production values"],"dislike":["Dislikes over‑reliance on CGI and excessive, unfocused plotlines","Avoids washed‑out colors, poor contrast, and clunky ship tech descriptions","Finds long hiatuses and stretched schedules detrimental to character arcs","Rejects heavy, offensive profanity and gratuitous violence","Prefers concise, purposeful storytelling over overstuffed casts and wasted performances"]}
